title: Swing the Rook Sideways
setup: Black's queen, rook and bishop all bear on your king on c7, and its own king is tucked away on a2.
hint: Your rook is on the wrong file but the right rank. Find the square where the only block costs a queen.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ra5+}} arrives along the fifth. {{Qa4}} is the only block, and {{Rxa4#}} is mate. The rook never moved forward — it moved across, which is the direction the a-file king could not answer.
